seo.homeDesc: Live football scores, today's fixtures and results, league tables, top scorers and football news from Egypt, Europe and leagues around the world.
seo.liveDesc: Follow every match in play with live scores, match minute and events, refreshed automatically without reloading the page.
seo.todayDesc: Today's football fixtures and results in your local time, across the Egyptian Premier League, Arab, European and global competitions.
seo.resultsDesc: The latest football results with goals and cards, grouped by day and competition and kept up to date.
seo.upcomingDesc: Upcoming matches across leagues and competitions in your local time, browsable day by day.
seo.leaguesDesc: Browse leagues and competitions — standings, fixtures, results, top scorers and teams, from the Egyptian Premier League to Europe's biggest leagues.
seo.standingsDesc: Up-to-date league tables with points, goals, goal difference and recent form for every club.
seo.scorersDesc: The season's leading scorers in each competition with goals, assists and appearances.
seo.teamsDesc: Team pages with the current squad, recent results, upcoming fixtures, league position and stadium details.
seo.newsDesc: The latest football headlines from reputable publishers — headline, short excerpt and a clear credit to the original source.
seo.leagueDesc: Everything about {name}: league table, fixtures, results, top scorers and teams, plus historical seasons.
seo.teamDesc: {name}: recent results, upcoming fixtures, current squad and league position.
seo.matchDesc: {home} vs {away} in {league}: score, goals, cards, substitutions and kick-off time in your local timezone.

news.title: Football News
news.subtitle: The latest headlines from reputable publishers. We show the headline and a short excerpt with a link to the original article.
news.emptyBody: No news sources are configured, or they are unreachable at the moment.
news.note: We publish the headline and a short excerpt only; all rights remain with the publisher, credited and linked.
